applicabilityBasis.summary: JPYm is marketed as a decentralized Japanese yen payment/FX stablecoin, but uses USDm-collateralized Liquity-v2 CDPs; the published redemption flow returns a digital asset rather than a contractual payment of yen. The reviewed sources do not identify a person obligated to redeem, convert or repurchase the token for a fixed amount of monetary value as section 2(22) requires. Payment marketing satisfies only one limb; applicability remains unclear, not conclusively excluded.

genius.notes: As of 2026-10-07, bounded regulator and issuer searches located no JPYm/Mento-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, official application, foreign registration/comparability decision, issuer-announced GENIUS route or public enforcement action. issuerEntity uses Mento Protocol as a factual protocol-family attribution, preserving the mento Safety Score issuer key; it does not identify a legal person, statutory GENIUS issuer or fiat-redemption obligor. The legal issuer, domicile and pathway remain unresolved. Mento Labs GmbH is described in protocol sources as an infrastructure/operations provider, not established as JPYm's fixed-fiat redemption issuer. Current governance includes upgrade/admin controls; the 2024 issuerless analysis is not conclusive and MGP-19 is a proposal, not proven execution. The protocol dashboard is public collateral disclosure, not evidence of GENIUS-compliant reserve composition or monthly independent attestation. Public CDP collateral-redemption documentation is present, but no public issuer 1:1 fiat-redemption policy was located. redemptionPolicyPresent is false under the tracker's fixed-fiat policy definition; the USDm collateral-redemption mechanism remains documented. The SCRC procedural rule is effective but issuer standards/application rules reviewed remain proposed; no earlier final-rule trigger was found. DASP status is a pre-effective assessment, conditional on scope, not permission or compliance. Treasury distinguishes foreign lawful-order conditions at effectiveness from the broader July 18 2028 DASP restriction.
